issues.description: Method getNameAndTotalNumberOfStudents: the UML in problem_statement.md declares getNameAndTotalNumberOfStudents() with return type void, but the textual task description specifies it should return a String formatted as "LectureName (TotalNumberOfStudents)", and the solution implementation (src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java) defines public String getNameAndTotalNumberOfStudents(). This contradiction between the UML and the textual description/solution can confuse students about the expected return type and whether they should implement a void method or a String-returning method.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the UML in problem_statement.md to declare getNameAndTotalNumberOfStudents(): String to match the textual description and the solution implementation. Ensure any template method signatures or unit tests (if present) also expect a String return type and update example usage in the statement accordingly.
